brief: Find a measured CRPS improvement on the frozen location-locked filter, or document why none exists.

step1_baseline_reproduction.result: PASS -- baseline reproduced exactly before any candidate was scored

constraints_honoured.mu: spread_line for every game; Gaussian is symmetric about mu so E[X] == mu to machine precision. No de-vig, no synthetic mu.
constraints_honoured.pit: expanding window only; beta folded into the running objective AFTER the current row is scored, so row i sees only rows j < i
constraints_honoured.refusal_rule: full-filter mean DeltaCRPS >= 0 is a terminal refusal; solos scored separately
constraints_honoured.gate_file: walk_forward.json NOT touched; emission stays the zero object
constraints_honoured.scoring_discipline: joint fitted and scored ONCE on the full filter; no confirmation block, no retuning, no best-of selection

solos.candidate: symmetric-pair asymmetric Laplace, mean locked at mu

joint.interpretation: beta_S sits at 0.000 on 1,456 of 2,462 rows -- the spread magnitude contributes essentially nothing once the total is in the model. All the signal is in beta_T (negative: higher totals narrow the residual).
joint.decision: improves, does NOT clear the gate

bug_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.symptom: The first heteroscedastic run returned mean_delta = +0.000000 with SE = 0.000000 on both candidates, and a beta histogram of {0.0: 2462}.
bug_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.diagnosis: The fitter minimised a LAPLACE-scale objective (b = base_b * mean(exp(beta*x))) while the scorer was GAUSSIAN. The two objectives do not share an optimum, so the grid search had no gradient to follow and returned beta=0 on every row. The candidate silently degenerated into the baseline.
bug_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.why_it_mattered: Reported as-is it would have looked like a legitimate refusal ('delta >= 0') when it was actually a non-measurement. A refusal and a bug look identical in the output.
bug_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.fix: Made the objective identical to the scorer (mean Gaussian CRPS over prior rows) and vectorised it with a running sum, which also cut runtime from O(n^2 * grid) hours to O(n * grid) seconds.
bug_found_and_fixed_during_this_run.after_fix: beta moved off zero and all 3 solos improved; the joint reached -0.011398.

second_bug_found.symptom: A docstring claimed Laplace CRPS at its own centre is b/2.
second_bug_found.truth: It is b/4: at y == mu, z = 0, so b*(0 + 1 - 0.75) = b/4. Verified by Monte Carlo over 200k draws (0.9935 vs 1.0000 closed form for b=4).
second_bug_found.fix: Corrected the comment; the closed-form code was already right.

third_bug_found.symptom: The first draft of the asymmetric-Laplace CRPS contained terms multiplied by 0.0 -- a derivation with no mathematical content that merely looked like one.
third_bug_found.fix: Replaced with the plain closed form. Fabricated-looking algebra is worse than no algebra.

ledger_finding_worth_recording.detail: The kill ledger contains 154 rows: 72 REFUSED, 6 GRADED, and exactly 2 with passed=true.
ledger_finding_worth_recording.trap: Both are labelled 'INFRASTRUCTURE PASS (diagnostic; provisional; not promoted)' with label=DIAGNOSTIC and promotion=NONE, and both were scored on the 570-game MANIFEST, not the 2,462-game frozen filter. Their nflverse cross-check values are 7.1376-7.2215 -- all above 7.099. Row LR-20261014-WF-RELABEL-NOT-CLEARED explicitly supersedes the second one with 'REFUSED (NOT CLEARED: technical pass on manifest only; nflverse cross-check above 7.099; best-of-8 selection)'.
ledger_finding_worth_recording.lesson: A grep for '"passed": true' in the ledger finds two hits that look like gate clears and are neither. Any future claim of a clear must name the filter, the n, and the cross-check.
